from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='b8a787b5b6c9df5bda03db4b5c9f3da67d80317a'
url='https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
code=r'''
import asyncio,json
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from tools.live_ats_inspect import allowed_url
URL="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65"
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  b=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
  try:
   page=await b.new_page(accept_downloads=False)
   async def guard(route):
    if route.request.is_navigation_request() and not allowed_url(route.request.url):
     await route.abort()
    else:await route.continue_()
   await page.route("**/*",guard)
   res=await page.goto(URL,wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=25000)
   await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
   links=await page.locator("a[href]").evaluate_all("""els=>els.map(e=>({text:(e.innerText||e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').trim().slice(0,80),href:e.href})).filter(x=>/apply|application/i.test(x.text+' '+x.href)).slice(0,25)""")
   safe=[{"text":x["text"],"url_host":urlsplit(x["href"]).hostname,"path":urlsplit(x["href"]).path[:160],"allowed":allowed_url(x["href"])} for x in links]
   print(json.dumps({"http_status":res.status if res else None,"links":safe,"applications_submitted":0,"clicked":False,"auth_attempted":False},sort_keys=True))
  finally:await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',code],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=65)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-4000:],'ERROR',e[-900:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('INSPECTION_FAILED')
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['clicked'] is False and r['auth_attempted'] is False and r['applications_submitted']==0
assert isinstance(r['links'],list)
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('READ_ONLY_LINK_DISCOVERY_OK',flush=True)
